main_text.p: [illegible, ~12 letters] Syr. Hilaris, [illegible, ~10 letters] Hilarem datorem diligit Deus, 2.ad Cor.9.7.
Ad חוב) Ex Ethpehal Syr. [illegible, ~8 letters] Quod debetur, ad Rom.4.4.&13.7. 1.ad Cor.7.3.
Ad חוא) [illegible, ~4 letters] Syr.Visus, Lucae 4.19. 2.ad Corinth.5.7.
Ad [illegible, ~6 letters] ) Item Confpectus [illegible, ~8 letters] In confpectu veftro, ad Rom.15.24.
Ad חלק) חלוק Ch.Indufium, Tunica interior, interrula, juxta R. Sal. & Aben Efram: ufitatum eft apud Talmudicos. Occurrit Exo.22.26. in Targ.Jon. Baal Aruch exponit Veftem exteriorem.
Ad חמם) Ex Pahel Part. מחממין כתנור Incalefcunt sicut furnus. Hof.7.7. Ithpaal מתחמם Calefaciens se-Genesi 18.17. in T.Hierosol.
Ad חטותא) Plur. חטין, חטות Hos. 4.8. Gen.18.17. in T.Hierosol.
Ad חמת) מחמת Propter, frequens apud Rabbinos: sequi solet ד, Esth.3.8.in T.sec. Scribitur ibi prave מהימרת.
Ad חסד) ܟܕܒܘܬܐ Syr.Criminator, conviciator, Plur. cum aff. ܟܕܒܝܢ ܠܟ ܡܢ Opprobrium opprobrantium tibi, ad Rom.15.3.
Ad חספא) Item Scabies sicca, vel ulcus שחין יבש בחספא Siccum sicut testa, ut Hebraei scribunt, Deut. 28.27. in T.Hierosol.

page.notes: The Syriac and Hebrew words are printed in their own scripts; those I could not read letter by letter are marked illegible rather than guessed. The last line is cut off at the foot of this part and continues on the next part. Hebrew and Syriac words are reproduced approximately from a small, faint scan; the Syriac and pointed Hebrew forms are doubtful. Text cut off at the top and left of this part.
